public_definitions: Goal: Review the weekend pop-up Units Sold by Product dashboard, then complete the Product B merchandising review intake by selecting the appropriate product route.
Chart Reference: Use the Units Sold by Product dashboard as the evidence source for the Product B merchandising route.

Option Labels: Keep Product B on regular merchandising plan, Route Product B for low-demand follow-up, Route Product B to urgent merchandising escalation, Route Product B to expanded replenishment planning, Route Product B to growth allocation review, Flag Product B for manual merchandising check

Policy Tables: Merchandising policy levels define routes based on unit conditions: < 3,000 units → Urgent escalation; >= 3,000 and < 5,200 → Demand follow-up; < 1,500 from threshold → Manual check; >= 20,000 and < 35,000 → Expanded replenishment; >= 35,000 → Growth review.
uncertain: Exact unit value for Product B is not labeled on the chart; visual estimation is required.
